sqlAgainstDeployNeondb.purpose: name the 19 zoning satisfied-present rows and coverage vs threshold
sqlAgainstDeployNeondb.sql: SELECT county_fips, rail_state, honest_coverage_pct, threshold_pct, source, verified_by_instrument, artifact_path, last_verified_at FROM county_facet_coverage WHERE facet = 'zoning' AND rail_state = 'satisfied-present' ORDER BY county_fips LIMIT 50;

sqlAgainstDeployNeondb.purpose: reconstruct A1-naive vs API-gated zoning counts (prove 19 vs 1)
sqlAgainstDeployNeondb.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE rail_state = 'satisfied-present')::int AS naive_satisfied_present, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rail_state = 'satisfied-present' AND honest_coverage_pct::numeric >= COALESCE(threshold_pct::numeric, 95))::int AS depth_gate_keeps, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rail_state = 'satisfied-present' AND (honest_coverage_pct IS NULL OR honest_coverage_pct::numeric < COALESCE(threshold_pct::numeric, 95)))::int AS depth_gate_demotes_to_not_yet FROM county_facet_coverage WHERE facet = 'zoning';

sqlAgainstDeployNeondb.purpose: A1-naive full-grid satisfied count (replicates score_cad_rails_fast.mjs ledger SQL)
sqlAgainstDeployNeondb.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE display_state = 'satisfied-present')::int AS naive_satisfied, count(*)::int AS total FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN r.atom_family_state <> 'present' THEN 'no-atom' WHEN r.has_writer = false THEN 'no-writer' WHEN c.rail_state IS NULL THEN 'not-yet' ELSE c.rail_state END AS display_state FROM county_manifest m CROSS JOIN county_rail r LEFT JOIN county_facet_coverage c ON c.county_fips = m.county_fips AND c.facet = r.rail_key) x;

sqlAgainstDeployNeondb.purpose: API-equivalent satisfied count with jurisdiction-depth gate (zoning/cad/landuse/owner/envelope/easement)
sqlAgainstDeployNeondb.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE kept)::int AS api_like_satisfied FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN r.atom_family_state <> 'present' THEN false WHEN r.has_writer = false THEN false WHEN c.rail_state IS NULL THEN false WHEN c.rail_state = 'satisfied-absent' THEN true WHEN c.rail_state = 'satisfied-present' AND r.rail_key IN ('cad','zoning','envelope','landuse','easement','owner') AND (c.honest_coverage_pct IS NULL OR c.honest_coverage_pct::numeric < COALESCE(c.threshold_pct::numeric, r.threshold_pct)) THEN false WHEN c.rail_state IN ('satisfied-present','satisfied-absent') THEN true ELSE false END AS kept FROM county_manifest m CROSS JOIN county_rail r LEFT JOIN county_facet_coverage c ON c.county_fips = m.county_fips AND c.facet = r.rail_key) x;
sqlAgainstDeployNeondb.note: Omits doctrine-source exclusion and derivation-indeterminate overlay; sufficient to attribute the 18-cell zoning demotion

sql.purpose: list atoms indexes with size + pg_stat scan/tuple counters
sql.sql: SELECT i.indexrelname, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid)) AS idx_size, pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid) AS idx_bytes, i.idx_scan, i.idx_tup_read, i.idx_tup_fetch, pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) AS indexdef FROM pg_stat_user_indexes i WHERE i.relname = 'atoms' ORDER BY pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid) DESC;

sql.purpose: atoms table size + estimated rows (reltuples; no count(*))
sql.sql: SELECT c.relname, c.reltuples::bigint AS reltuples_est, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(c.oid)) AS heap_size, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)) AS total_size, pg_relation_size(c.oid) AS heap_bytes, pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS total_bytes FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'atoms';

sql.purpose: index predicates / uniqueness / columns from pg_index
sql.sql: SELECT ic.relname AS index_name, i.indisunique, i.indisprimary, i.indpred IS NOT NULL AS is_partial, pg_get_expr(i.indpred, i.indrelid) AS pred, pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) AS indexdef FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_class tc ON tc.oid = i.indrelid WHERE tc.relname = 'atoms' ORDER BY ic.relname;

sql.purpose: column stats for section_number / jurisdiction selectivity (no heap scan)
sql.sql: SELECT tablename, attname, null_frac, n_distinct, correlation, most_common_vals::text AS mcv, most_common_freqs::text AS mcf FROM pg_stats WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'atoms' AND attname IN ('section_number','jurisdiction','entity_type','entity_id') ORDER BY attname;
